{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Colorado Lateral Gas Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Cheyenne Hub, Colorado to Greeley, Colorado.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2008-01-18/pdf/E8-864.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Kinder Morgan Interstate Gas Transmission LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2008-01-18/pdf/E8-864.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''57 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2008-01-18/pdf/E8-864.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''41.4 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2008-01-18/pdf/E8-864.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''12 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2008-01-18/pdf/E8-864.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2007<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2008-01-18/pdf/E8-864.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
